tools.name: check_mail_security
tools.description: Run a live SPF, DMARC, DKIM, MX, TXT, DNS, and registrar posture check for a public domain. Returns a compact summary with SPF/DMARC/DKIM records, DKIM selector, MX hosts, external DMARC destinations, score/grade, and report URL. Invocation: browser WebMCP only — open this site, discover tools via the page runtime, then execute here. There is no public HTTP execute_url; do not reverse-engineer the app bundle for a REST path. Agent-friendly: no interactive CAPTCHA.

tools.name: export_mail_security_report
tools.description: Export the latest mail-security-check results. Formats: copy (clipboard HTML/text for email), pdf (download), or email (send report to a recipient). Email format requires name, company, email, and found_us (e.g. ["search"]). Call check_mail_security first if no results are on the page. Invocation: browser WebMCP page runtime only (no public HTTP execute_url). Agent-friendly: no interactive CAPTCHA required.

found_us.description: How the user found this product (required for email format)

tools.name: open_get_started
tools.description: Open the Email Security Monitor sign-up / get-started flow so a user can begin managed DMARC monitoring. Browser WebMCP page runtime only (no public HTTP execute_url).

tools.name: open_sign_in
tools.description: Open the Email Security Monitor sign-in page for existing users. Browser WebMCP page runtime only (no public HTTP execute_url).
